key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare, amplifying import costs and fuel price pressure (+30c/L)
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate-cut timing
ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 job cuts faces execution risk
Housing prices crashing with first-home buyer surge; no spring bounce in auctions
Oil price surge from failed suppression efforts threatens energy sector dynamics
Mining cap raises accelerating (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress in juniors
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian LNG supply fears (Santos.AX relevant)
Superannuation reform debate intensifying with populist pressure vs. institutional concerns

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners leading the $90bn index decline. Junior miners rushing cap raises via Canaccord, signalling liquidity stress. Gold miners (Kuniko, Gateway WA) finding relative safe-haven interest.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NGT.AX) and battery-tech (Critical Resources) offer diversification. Avoid junior miners with dilutive raises.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure bank valuations. ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts faces execution risk. RBA rental inflation concern delays rate-cut expectations.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX under pressure from yield curve steepening. Net interest margin outlook mixed. ANZ.AX specifically at risk from transformation cost overruns.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive. Oil price surge from failed suppression benefits upstream producers. Australia softening gas supply rules supports Santos.AX and LNG exporters. Fuel prices +30c/L pressures downstream.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX benefit from policy easing and oil strength. Boral.AX, downstream refiners face margin squeeze. LNG export flexibility is a positive structural signal.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths.AX breached its own 'Price Freeze' on four staples, eroding consumer trust. Housing crash boosting first-home buyers but broader consumer confidence deteriorating. Businesses 'fear for their future.'
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WES.AX face margin and reputational risk. Defensive staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) may see rotation but pricing power questioned. Housing-linked retail (REA.AX, LPX.AX) under pressure.

sectors.trend: Neutral-to-positive. Global biotech active (Biogen, Novo Nordisk, BioMarin, Teva). ASX small-caps (Neurizon, Australasian) showing relative strength. NDIS funding cuts signal domestic policy risk.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Small-cap biotech (NRZ.AX, AAL.AX) showing momentum but NDIS cuts create policy overhang for domestic health services.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing prices crashing, no auction spring bounce. NZ five-year correction still running. Property chiefs calling for more migrants to build supply. Rental inflation keeps RBA cautious.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Residential property developers under stress. Rental inflation supports commercial REIT pricing but caps rate cuts.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and rising bond yields driving broad ASX sell-off
Iron ore price deterioration as primary drag on materials sector
AUD weakness amplifying imported inflation and fuel costs
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
Housing market correction accelerating across Australia and NZ
Mining sector capital stress with junior cap raises
Oil price surge from failed OPEC+ suppression
Superannuation reform debate creating policy uncertainty
Consumer pricing power under scrutiny (Woolworths breach)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore (FMG.AX, RIO.AX); diversify into gold and battery metals
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor RBA intervention signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy misstep (rental inflation vs growth)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain cash buffers; avoid over-leveraged property positions; watch RBA statement language

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining sector dilution / cap raise wave
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid junior miners with imminent raises; focus on cash-flow-positive producers
Reduce residential REIT and developer exposure; monitor auction clearance rates weekly

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / fuel cost shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour upstream energy (Santos.AX, WDS.AX); avoid transport and logistics names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and battery metals as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Gold 'schmould' but safe-haven bid intact; battery tech (Critical Resources) in month-long test phase; Kuniko and Gateway WA showing exploration upside

opportunities.recommendation: Add upstream energy on oil surge and gas policy easing
opportunities.rationale: Oil price suppression failing; Australia softening gas supply rules supports LNG exporters; Santos preservation signals policy support

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank entry on yield-driven weakness
opportunities.rationale: Rising bond yields support NIMs long-term; ANZ.AX restructuring may create value trap opportunity post-execution

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and pure-play materials exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; $90bn ASX loss led by miners; no near-term demand catalyst
Rate uncertainty, AUD weakness, and growth scare create volatility; preserve capital pending RBA clarity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight residential property and housing-linked names
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing crash accelerating, no auction bounce, NZ correction ongoing; rental inflation limits rate-cut tailwind

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to test lower supports as iron ore weakness, AUD depreciation, and oil-driven inflation fears persist. RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare limits policy flexibility. Expect continued volatility in materials and financials. 1-3 month: further 3-5% downside risk on ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may create entry points for quality REITs and developers. Energy sector structurally supported by gas policy reform. Superannuation reform, if managed well, could unlock long-term capital flows. Iron ore stabilisation likely within 6-9 months. 6-12 month: recovery contingent on RBA pivoting and commodity stabilisation.

ANZ.AX restructuring progress and cost-out delivery
OPEC+ oil supply decisions and fuel price pass-through
watch_list: ASX small-cap cap raise volume (Canaccord pipeline)
NZ housing price index (continuation of correction)
Oil Brent spot and Australian fuel pump prices
